verdict.rationale: GitLab documents a public REST API for automating workflows, managing CI/CD and controlling user access. The API is described by an autogenerated OpenAPI 3.0 spec with an interactive request tool, and supports Bearer/OAuth 2.0 auth via personal access tokens. A documented semantic-versioning and deprecation policy also covers v4. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works well for AI-driven use.
